title: Christ Church Cathedral
geometryBasis: Native building outline, measured local terrain, contemporary architectural description and the exact published Qualla public-domain harbour photograph.
sectionBasis: The red corrugated steep nave roof falls toward the lower ancillary rooms. Local granite is outlined with brick at the openings and buttresses. Four clocks sit above paired belfry openings under the iron spire.
limitations: Uses the historic roof profile and brickwork with approximations for less visible ancillary doors, stained glass, clock fittings and small roof ornaments. The adjacent Whalebone Arch is a separate mapped structure.
